rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for nightlife in general, including going to nightclubs.

example.english: Hong Kong's nightlife is quite lively; you don't necessarily have to go to bars.
example.traditional: 香港嘅夜生活幾豐富，唔一定要去酒吧。
example.jyutping: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 je6 sang1 wut6 gei2 fung1 fu3 m4 jat1 ding6 jiu3 heoi3 zau2 baa1

rows.note: Use this colloquial term when the focus is on partying or going clubbing at night rather than nightlife in general.

example.english: Are we going out for nightlife tonight?
example.jyutping: gam1 maan1 heoi3 m4 heoi3 je6 pou4

rows.note: Use this when nightlife means the nightclub scene or the night-time entertainment venues themselves.

example.english: The nightlife venues in Tsim Sha Tsui are still packed at two in the morning.
example.traditional: 尖沙咀啲夜場，凌晨兩點仲係好旺。
example.jyutping: zim1 saa1 zeoi2 di1 je6 coeng4 ling4 san4 loeng5 dim2 zung6 hai6 hou2 wong6
